queries.status: SELECT 'CAPACITY',@@GLOBAL.max_connections; SHOW GLOBAL STATUS WHERE Variable_name IN ('Threads_connected','Threads_running','Max_used_connections','Connections','Uptime','Innodb_row_lock_current_waits','Innodb_row_lock_waits','Innodb_row_lock_time','Innodb_buffer_pool_reads','Innodb_buffer_pool_read_requests','Innodb_data_reads','Innodb_data_writes','Innodb_data_read','Innodb_data_written','Innodb_log_waits','Com_commit','Com_rollback','Handler_commit','Binlog_commits','Binlog_group_commits','Innodb_os_log_fsyncs','Innodb_data_fsyncs','Innodb_os_log_written','Innodb_log_writes','Innodb_buffer_pool_pages_total','Innodb_buffer_pool_pages_data','Innodb_buffer_pool_pages_dirty','Innodb_buffer_pool_pages_free','Innodb_buffer_pool_wait_free','Innodb_buffer_pool_bytes_data','Innodb_buffer_pool_bytes_dirty','Innodb_buffer_pool_pages_flushed','Innodb_lsn_current','Innodb_lsn_flushed','Innodb_lsn_last_checkpoint','Innodb_redo_log_current_lsn','Innodb_redo_log_checkpoint_lsn','Innodb_redo_log_flushed_to_disk_lsn','Innodb_redo_log_logical_size','Innodb_redo_log_physical_size','Innodb_redo_log_capacity_resized','Innodb_redo_log_resize_status'); SELECT 'LOCKS',COUNT(*) FROM performance_schema.data_lock_waits; SELECT 'DIGEST_TOTAL',COUNT(*),COALESCE(SUM(COUNT_STAR),0),COALESCE(SUM(SUM_TIMER_WAIT),0),COALESCE(SUM(SUM_LOCK_TIME),0),COALESCE(SUM(SUM_ROWS_EXAMINED),0) FROM performance_schema.events_statements_summary_by_digest; SELECT 'FILE_IO_TOTAL',COALESCE(SUM(COUNT_WRITE),0),COALESCE(SUM(SUM_TIMER_WRITE),0),COALESCE(SUM(SUM_NUMBER_OF_BYTES_WRITE),0),COALESCE(SUM(COUNT_READ),0),COALESCE(SUM(SUM_TIMER_READ),0),COALESCE(SUM(SUM_NUMBER_OF_BYTES_READ),0) FROM performance_schema.file_summary_by_event_name WHERE EVENT_NAME LIKE 'wait/io/file/innodb/%' OR EVENT_NAME='wait/io/file/sql/binlog';
queries.config: SHOW GLOBAL VARIABLES WHERE Variable_name IN ('innodb_buffer_pool_size','innodb_page_size','innodb_log_buffer_size','innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit','sync_binlog','innodb_dedicated_server','innodb_buffer_pool_instances','innodb_redo_log_capacity','innodb_autoinc_lock_mode','innodb_io_capacity','innodb_io_capacity_max','innodb_flush_neighbors');
queries.waits: SELECT 'WAIT_COVERAGE',COUNT(*),SUM(i.ENABLED='YES'),SUM(i.TIMED='YES'),SUM(e.COUNT_STAR),SUM(e.SUM_TIMER_WAIT) FROM performance_schema.events_waits_summary_global_by_event_name e JOIN performance_schema.setup_instruments i ON i.NAME=e.EVENT_NAME WHERE (e.EVENT_NAME LIKE 'wait/io/file/innodb/%' OR e.EVENT_NAME='wait/io/file/sql/binlog' OR e.EVENT_NAME LIKE 'wait/synch/%/innodb/%'); SELECT e.EVENT_NAME,i.ENABLED,i.TIMED,e.COUNT_STAR,e.SUM_TIMER_WAIT,e.MIN_TIMER_WAIT,e.MAX_TIMER_WAIT FROM performance_schema.events_waits_summary_global_by_event_name e JOIN performance_schema.setup_instruments i ON i.NAME=e.EVENT_NAME WHERE (e.EVENT_NAME LIKE 'wait/io/file/innodb/%' OR e.EVENT_NAME='wait/io/file/sql/binlog' OR e.EVENT_NAME LIKE 'wait/synch/%/innodb/%') ORDER BY e.SUM_TIMER_WAIT DESC,e.EVENT_NAME LIMIT 20;
